title: docs(releases): date 18.0.0 by its npm publish day, and the v17 page stops saying a plain install resolves 17.7.0
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DVnDhkexGgHMmRmgKicPYPa)_

Fixes #25148

## What changed

Docs only, two files under `content/docs/releases/` (+4 / -3). No script moves in this PR, per the card.

| Page | Before | After | Source |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/releases/index.mdx:21` (`/docs/releases`), v18 entry | `(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-19)` | `(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-20)` | npm `time["18.0.0"]` = `2026-10-20T12:51:40.837Z` (read from `registry.npmjs.org/@objectstack/spec` at 2026-10-23); the Version Packages commit `06cab4849` (#24524) is dated `2026-10-20T11:47:07Z`; `releases/v18/18-0.mdx` already says "published 2026-10-20" |
| `content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx:25` (`/docs/releases/v17`), status blockquote | "A plain install now resolves 17.7.0." | "A plain install resolved 17.7.0 until 2026-10-20, when 18.0.0 took npm's `latest` tag; a plain install now resolves the [v18](/docs/releases/v18) line." | npm `dist-tags` = `{latest: 18.0.0, next: 18.0.0-next.5, rc: 17.0.0-rc.6}` (same read) |

The index field keeps the exact `current series: X.Y.Z, released YYYY-MM-DD` shape, because `sync-release-index-currency.mjs`'s `STATUS_SHAPE` refuses a field with anything after the date; the sources therefore live here, not in the parenthetical. The v17 sentence names the v18 line rather than `18.0.0`, so it does not go stale again at 18.1.0.

## Premise, measured

- `origin/main` `54df640` read both stale sentences as the card quotes them; 18.1.0 is not cut (the index still names 18.0.0, `latest` is 18.0.0).
- The cause the card gives holds: `8fbbd5082` (#24584, 2026-10-19T16:51Z) wrote "released 2026-10-19" before the cut; at the version commit the field already named the newest GA, so the script left it, date included (`rewriteStatusField` returns null for a same-version field). On this branch `node scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` exits 0 with "nothing rewritten".

## Done-when 2: should the currency script verify the date it leaves in place?

Yes, but not in this PR (the card forbids a code change in a docs PR), so it is reported to the seat as an out-of-scope finding. The reading:

- The script's refusal to re-date a same-version field is right for prerelease cuts (its header records the 17.7.0 re-dating it prevents). The gap is narrower: the run that IS the version commit of the newest GA, where the field was pre-written by hand. That run is detectable without a clock or network: the newest GA in the committed `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` at `HEAD` differs from the newest GA after `changeset version`. On that run, and only that run, the date it holds is true, so it should stamp it even when the version already matches.
- A check-only alternative (compare the date to npm `time`) needs the network at version time and so cannot be the guard on the `version-pr` lane.

## Gates

Head `9be39f2`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 48 commands for the two changed paths. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`; `--ran` reconciles 48 derived, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. All 48 exit 0, among them `check:release-page-status`, `check:release-notes`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs --strict`, `check:doc-anchors` and `check:docs`. `check:docs-transcript-drift` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, lint not built); after `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` were built under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0) it exits 0.

Not measured locally, CI's: Build Docs, Test Core, the type-check lanes and the wide-population families. No package source moves, so no test or ablation applies. `content/docs/**` is in no package's `files[]`, so this carries `skip-changeset` and no changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- The attribution block's first line is an HTML comment the session requires; `os-dev.md` forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Same shape as PRs #25255 and #25322; reported as a deviation.
- The branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-bb3ks9`; the claim (comment `6355543510`) records it as the identity.
